about_the_game:
GAME STORY

The game "My place is cursed" is about a man who becomes the manager of his grandfather's apartment building, where strange and unusual occurrences begin to happen. However, amidst the strange happenings, meet various experiences, such as meeting the girls in the building and forming a relationship with them. The next part of the story is up to you, as the player, to decide how it will end.

ANIMATED H SCENE

Every H-scene in the game is meticulously hand-animated frame by frame—no motion tweening—giving each moment a rich, expressive, and handcrafted feel.

And thanks to this technique, we can create continuous H-scenes that feel truly alive—each moment flowing naturally

GAME SYSTEM

🗺️ Map Feature – Now you can explore even more areas with the new map system, allowing you to travel between locations seamlessly. 🌍

  • Thai (Official Translation)

  • Spanish (AI Translation)

  • Japanese  (AI Translation)

  • Chinese (AI Translation)

  • Russian  (AI Translation)

🔮 Guide Vision – Easily find interactive objects with the new Guide Vision system. No more missing out on hidden secrets! 🌟

Day System: 

The Day system is a significant addition to the game. It plays a crucial role in influencing events and interactions. When your character sleeps or certain in-game events occur, the day may change. Additionally, some character meetings and quests will now require you to be in the right location on the correct day, adding a new layer of realism and strategy to your gameplay

Time System: 

Our Time system is another exciting feature that adds depth to your gaming experience. Time will now pass as you progress through the game and encounter various events. This dynamic element will impact how you approach challenges and decisions, making the game world feel more alive and responsive to your actions.

Hint System (Improvement) :

We've significantly upgraded the quest system, making it easier for players to complete quests. The hint system has also been overhauled to be clearer, more understandable, and more player-friendly.

The Inventory system has been added in this update. It will now provide you with a clear view of the items you possess. This will be especially useful when you need to use specific items to complete quests or overcome obstacles.

name: MY PLACE IS CURSED Demo
short_description: This game is an adult visual novel and dating sim where you manage your grandfather's apartment, experiencing strange events and building relationships with tenants. Features include a gallery system, cheat codes, fast travel, day/time mechanics, inventory, and multi-language support.
